name: How do I determine a realistic budget for a rental income property purchase?

mainEntity.name: How do I determine a realistic budget for a rental income property purchase?

acceptedAnswer.text: To determine a realistic budget for a rental income property, consider the property's purchase price, closing costs, renovation expenses, and ongoing operating costs like property taxes, insurance, and maintenance. Lenders will also assess your debt-to-income ratio. Kelby Contreras assists clients in developing a comprehensive financial picture tailored to investment properties, factoring in potential rental income to assess profitability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Determine your budget by including purchase price, closing costs, renovations, and ongoing operating expenses, plus potential rental income.
